courses.alignment: Explain a fictional enterprise mission, trading arrangement and innovation hypothesis while distinguishing proposed value from demonstrated outcomes.
Analyse fictional demand evidence and develop a bounded value proposition that distinguishes user need, payer demand and access conditions.
Calculate elementary costs, contribution and cash movements for a fictional enterprise, stating assumptions and limits without providing investment or tax advice.
Compare fictional finance and member-governance arrangements for obligations, control, access and mission, without soliciting funds or advising investments.
Develop a proportionate fictional impact enquiry and accountable mission review, distinguishing activity, outcome, contribution and unsupported causal claims.
Integrate mission, market, operations, finance, governance and impact into a conditional fictional launch proposal with explicit review and authority gates.

boundaries: FGR houses donor fundraising and grants; VTS houses occupational skills; RDS houses advanced research methods; LMI houses organisational management. SEE integrates enterprise viability with mission.
All exercises and transactions fictional; real financial, employment, tax and legal decisions require qualified advice and authority.
Learning materials may be owner-released after accurate build and private verification. New CBT and school exam IDs remain blank until genuinely configured.
Public source assessment examples are disclosed review material; unpublished production banks required before graded ParaLearn launch.
Full-school enrolment and certification require separate readiness, moderated exam and authorised signatures.
depth_and_follow_on: Not equivalent to a university entrepreneurship degree or regulated finance competence. Further provision must cover supervised real-world work, advanced research and finance, and verified current Nigerian legal/tax requirements. Course duration is proposed pending piloting.
